lines.text: Scripture says Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.
Moses speaks of the blessedness of the man to whom God credits righteousness apart from works.
Abraham's faith was credited to him before he was circumcised, and circumcision came as a seal.
Abraham was about fifty years old, and Sarah's womb was lifeless, yet his faith did not weaken.
Jesus was delivered over to death for our trespasses and raised to life for our justification.
